title: V-Engram: Trigger-Indexed External Memory for Modular Text-to-Image Personalization
abstract: arXiv:2609.37198v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained text-to-image models contain broad visual knowledge, yet they cannot reliably acquire or refine a specific visual identity from only a few references while preserving compositional control. Token-embedding methods are compact but often underfit identity, whereas adapter-based methods improve fidelity through persistent weight updates that can be costly to store and interfere when concepts are composed. We introduce V-Engram, a trigger-indexed external memory mechanism for Stable Diffusion 3.5. Each concept is assigned an explicit trigger that retrieves concept-specific memory, whose gated directions enter frozen text-encoder and MMDiT context states as relative residuals. Separating this memory from backbone adaptation enables prompt-selective and multi-concept access without merging model updates. translated_title: V-Engram：用于模块化文生图个性化的触发器索引外部记忆
translated_abstract: 预训练的文生图模型包含广泛的视觉知识，然而它们无法在保持组合控制的同时，仅凭少量参考图像可靠地获取或精炼特定的视觉身份。令牌嵌入方法虽然紧凑，但常常对身份的拟合不足；而基于适配器的方法通过持久的权重更新来提升保真度，但这些更新的存储成本高昂，且在多个概念组合时会相互干扰。我们提出了V-Engram，这是一种面向Stable Diffusion 3.5的触发器索引外部记忆机制。每个概念被分配一个显式触发器，该触发器用于检索概念特定的记忆，其门控方向作为相对残差进入冻结的文本编码器和MMDiT上下文状态。将这种记忆与骨干网络适配相分离，使得无需合并模型更新即可实现提示词选择性访问与多概念访问。实验表明，V-Engram在整体主体保真度上与DreamBooth-LoRA大致相当，同时在（摘要在此处截断）等设置中显示出优势。
tldr: V-Engram为Stable Diffusion 3.5提出了一种触发器索引的外部记忆机制，通过显式触发器检索概念特定记忆并以相对残差形式注入冻结的文本编码器和MMDiT状态，从而在不合并模型更新的情况下实现提示词选择性和多概念的文生图个性化。
en_tdlr: V-Engram introduces a trigger-indexed external memory mechanism for Stable Diffusion 3.5, where explicit triggers retrieve concept-specific memory injected as gated relative residuals into frozen text-encoder and MMDiT states, enabling prompt-selective, multi-concept text-to-image personalization without merging model updates.
